faqs.a: US$300, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$300 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.
The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: Is Kramuzgolu safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.
The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

bottomLine: For a cautious newcomer, Kramuzgolu can work: start on the demo, deposit the US$300 minimum and keep your own numbers.
We rate it 4.5 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$300 minimum is the right size for testing either.
